crossRefs.note: Nathan spoke to David all these words, and according to all this vision.
The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is…
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.
translations.bsb: So Nathan relayed to David all the words of this entire revelation.
translations.kjv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
translations.asv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
